About Animals Go Kart 2

Animal Go Kart 2 is the fully 3D sequel to Animals Kart! Pick one of 8 cute animal drivers – Cat, Bunny, Panda, Fox, Duck, Frog, Rhino and Squirrel – and race on 8 colorful 3D tracks: Blue Coast, Desert Canyon, Jungle Falls, Future City, Snow Peak, Lava Mountain, Cloud Kingdom and Royal Castle. Climb hills, fly off ramps, cross real bridges and race through rain, snow, sandstorms and neon lights. Drift around corners to fill your boost bar, slipstream rivals and nail the rocket start. Grab the ? item boxes for boosts, bananas, homing orbs and the unstoppable star. Win the Grand Prix cups in 50cc, 100cc, 150cc and Mirror mode to collect bronze, silver and gold trophies, or beat your own ghost in Time Trial to earn medals on every track. Fast, colorful kart racing for everyone, on mobile and desktop!
